crossing_definition.interpolation: bisection on the continuous phase inside the bracket
crossing_definition.predicate: strict branch active while phi_off < wrap(atan2(x, xc)) < phi_on
crossing_definition.utc_mapping: a crossing instant maps to elapsed hours; a candidate test maps elapsed hours to UTC instants on its own sampling grid
crossing_definition.wrap_handling: the phase series is unwrapped, so rotation across +/-pi is never a crossing and the A-branch jump at phi_off is not one

description: Piecewise synthesis drive A(phi) on the wrapped source phase, including the Lead-corrected one-sided boundary semantics.
evaluation_order: A = a*activation/normalization and B = G*alpha*(1-n)*(1-b*x)*(1-b*xc) follow the pinned source order (multiplication is not associative).
notes: Strict branch selection: phi_off < phi < phi_on; the complementary branch is selected at both boundaries.
Lead source-check correction: the inside limit at phi_on is zero (not a); at phi_off the inside limit is a while the boundary selects the small constant branch, i.e. a real jump.
exp(-600*span) underflows to 0.0 in float64, so the normalization is exactly 1.0 and A(phi_off + eps) == a exactly for eps < ~0.519.
Periodicity holds because the source evaluates the branch on the wrapped atan2 output.

one_sided_limits.tolerance_reason: near-boundary regime: the source evaluates the branch on the wrapped atan2 phase, so the branch difference is recoverable only to ~1e-16 rad; with delta=600 that becomes a relative activation error of ~1e-16/eps.  The band is max(1e-9, 1e-15/eps) and applies to this family only; the global rtol stays 1e-9.
